questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part that contains an error: The convoy, together with the sapper detachment, / have been halted / at the defile / since dawn.
options: The convoy, together with the sapper detachment
questions.explanation: Phrases like together with do not make the subject plural. Use has been halted.
